_comment: Differential corpus for pausedAt(tMs, paused, pausedSince, pauses): whether the manual freeze covered the instant tMs. `paused` is the settings flag as a boolean, `pausedSince` the open pause's start (written with the flag), and `pauses` the closed intervals exactly as the ctf:admin:pauses list stores them, one JSON string {from, to} per entry. A closed interval covers [from, to): frozen at the instant the organizer paused, live again at the instant they resumed. An open pause covers everything from pausedSince on; one whose start is absent or unparseable covers every instant, because when it began is unknown. Entries that do not parse, lack a bound or run backwards cover nothing. Duplicated verbatim in apps/web/src/lib/schedule-window.ts, scorer/src/store.js and sync/src/redis.js; each reader's suite runs every row here against its own copy. F = 2023-11-14T22:13:20.000Z (1700000000000), T = F + 1h.

cases.description: never paused
open pause, one ms before it began: live
open pause, exactly when it began: frozen
open pause, long after it began: frozen
open pause with no recorded start: frozen at any instant
open pause with an unparseable start: frozen at any instant
flag off with a stale start left behind: the flag decides
closed interval, one ms before from: live
closed interval, exactly at from: frozen
closed interval, one ms before to: frozen
closed interval, exactly at to: live again
key order inside an entry does not matter
second of two intervals covers the instant
between a closed interval and a later open pause: live
an entry that is not JSON covers nothing
an entry with unparseable bounds covers nothing
an entry missing its end covers nothing
an entry that is JSON but not an object covers nothing
a backwards entry covers nothing
a junk entry does not hide a valid one
